description: List all audiences (lists) available in the current Mailchimp session.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with 'lists' (array of list objects) and 'total_items'; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single audience (list) by its id.

list_id.description: The unique id of the list.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the list object; on failure (list not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the members of an audience (list), optionally filtered by subscription status.

list_id.description: The unique id of the list.

status.description: Optional member status to filter by (e.g. subscribed, unsubscribed, cleaned).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with 'members', 'list_id', and 'total_items'; on failure (list not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single list member by subscriber hash or raw email address.

list_id.description: The unique id of the list.

subscriber_hash.description: The subscriber hash (MD5 of the lowercased email) or the raw email address of the member.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the member object; on failure (member not found), output contains an error message.

description: Add a new member to an audience (list).

list_id.description: The unique id of the list to add the member to.

email_address.description: The email address of the new member.

full_name.description: Optional full name of the member.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created member object; on failure (list not found or member already exists), output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing list member by subscriber hash or raw email address.

list_id.description: The unique id of the list.

subscriber_hash.description: The subscriber hash (MD5 of the lowercased email) or the raw email address of the member.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated member object; on failure (member not found), output contains an error message.

description: List campaigns, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: Optional campaign status to filter by (e.g. sent, save).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with 'campaigns' (array) and 'total_items'; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single campaign by its id.

campaign_id.description: The unique id of the campaign.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the campaign object; on failure (campaign not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new campaign targeting an audience (list).

list_id.description: The unique id of the recipient list.

subject_line.description: The subject line of the campaign.

from_name.description: The from name shown to recipients.

reply_to.description: The reply-to email address for the campaign.

title.description: Optional internal title for the campaign.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created campaign object; on failure (list not found), output contains an error message.

description: Send a campaign, marking it as sent and generating a report if one does not already exist.

campaign_id.description: The unique id of the campaign to send.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output describes the sent campaign (id, status, emails_sent); on failure (campaign not found or already sent), output contains an error message.

description: Get the performance report for a campaign by its id.

campaign_id.description: The unique id of the campaign.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the report object (emails_sent, opens, clicks, unsubscribed, bounces); on failure (no report or campaign not found), output contains an error message.
